en.title: Minimum Operations from Zero by Adding One or Doubling
en.description:
Start from 0; each step either adds 1 or multiplies by 2. Find the minimum number of operations to reach each target value. The first part of the original text is missing; the set of operations is restored from the original description and the ADD_1 and MULTIPLY_2 examples.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n values of k; full bounds from the original text: 1≤n≤10000, 0≤k≤10000000000000000.
en.output: Output n lines with the minimum number of operations, in input order.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 4 / 3; 0 / 1 / 4; 5 / 5 / 9. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: For a positive number, the answer is its number of binary digits minus one, plus its number of 1 bits; for 0 the answer is simply 0.
